legal_audit.registration: Existing NonMatching registration and split unchanged. Tested static inline helpers existed only in the assigned C translation unit, never shared or out of line in the retained candidate.

hypothesis.description: Function-local static inline helper boundaries may retain independently optimized entry-base, table-base and tail-base expression nodes after inlining, unlike source-level local aliases. The helper loop is optimized before substitution of State member arguments.
hypothesis.difference_from_prior: Prior experiments changed aliases, global views, or induction expressions within fn_801FD318. These tests introduce separate inline function optimization boundaries with parameterized table/entry/tail inputs; no linker alias syntax or compiler policy change.
hypothesis.result: Partial codegen effect but no score improvement: inlined table loop emits 200 bytes at 75.71154%, computing +0x7c, +0xf8, etc. from an entries base instead of the baseline State-relative midpoint. Table and tail bases still fold to r31; retail separately materializes r12 and r3. Explicit helper stores score 37.46154% at 228 bytes; two six-entry and three four-entry helper calls score 43.98077% at 220 bytes.

relocation_conclusion: ELF RELA dumps show the same eight external relocation target/type/addend triples (all addends zero). Float-load and global-store relocation offsets differ. Strict objdiff remains 75.84615%, not a byte or relocation-strict match.
